actors.name: Rosa Maria
actors.private_context: Rosa Maria is Jonas's manager. She has prepared a promotion case for Jonas and wants it to clear calibration and receive VP sign-off before November 15. She is aware of the promotion letter deadline.

actors.name: Jonas
actors.private_context: Jonas is Rosa Maria's report. He is aware that Rosa Maria is working on his promotion case but does not know the details of the calibration or VP sign-off process.

actors.name: VP
actors.private_context: The VP is responsible for signing off on promotion cases. They have not yet seen Jonas's case. They have other priorities and may need to review the case before signing.

shared_context: The company has a promotion calibration process where managers present cases for their reports. After calibration, cases require VP sign-off. Promotion letters are scheduled to go out on November 15, 2026. The current date is October 5, 2026.

starting_events.description: Rosa Maria has prepared Jonas's promotion case and is ready to submit it for calibration.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Jonas's promotion case cleared calibration and received VP sign-off before November 15, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
